quest.title: Miracle Medicine
quest.description: Anthony requested a prescription from a master physician in Liyue Harbor that can be used to heal Anna.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Well, it might sound hard to believe, but Anna says that she's been feeling much better.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Perhaps that doctor's prescription is really working? I can scarcely believe it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Well, regardless of whether it's true or not, it's best to keep going.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: The prescription this time is... Hmm. Could you help me find "Thick Condensate of a Hydro Slime"?

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Um, really? I actually think the opposite is true.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: But at least it's easy to find. I've asked around, and they say that you can get Thick Condensate just by defeating Large Slimes.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I've heard Jack say that you can lure Large Slimes out by constantly defeating smaller ones.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I don't have that kind of combat skill, so I'm counting on you!

choices.text: Don't worry, this one might be edible.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: And how do you know that? Have you tried it before? ...Um, why aren't you saying anything?

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Whatever. Hydro Slimes should be quite easy to find. I've asked around, and others have said that you can get Thick Condensate by defeating Large Slimes.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I've heard Jack say that you can lure Large Slimes out by constantly defeating smaller ones.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I don't have that kind of combat skill, so I'm counting on you!

choices.text: I know where to get some.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Well, that's good. Looks like you're well-versed in dealing with Slimes.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Thanks for agreeing to help. You should be able to get some Thick Condensate just by defeating Large Slimes.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I've heard Jack say that you can lure Large Slimes out by constantly defeating smaller ones.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Well then, best of luck to you.

talks.objective: Acquire some Thick Hydro Slime Condensate

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Well, it is combat we're talking about. Take some time to prepare, and I'll see you again.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: This... really does look quite rich.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Can you really use this to make medicine? I'll try it myself once it's done.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: If anything happens to me, please take Anna...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: ...and place her in the care of Sister Grace.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Tell her that I've gone to work somewhere far abroad. Please, that is my final request.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey, hey. You're giving yourself a scare.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: But this medicine does look that scary! Whatever the case, take this first.
